verdict.rationale: SumUp documents an official managed MCP server at https://mcp.sumup.com/mcp. It lets MCP clients manage the account, create checkouts and process payments via the Cloud API, and also offers documentation tools. An Agent Toolkit with MCP support complements it, and a probe confirmed the MCP server docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the endpoint works, and documented details on authentication, setup and the full tool list.
